blocks.text:
The programme ends with a transfer to Cancún, so you can extend your trip with time at the beach after the sightseeing portion if you wish. The main excursions and transfers take place in a group. Guides along the route speak English and Spanish; additional English-speaking assistance can be arranged at extra cost.

The domestic flight from Mexico City to Mérida is not included in the tour price. To take part in the activities planned for day 4, you need to arrive in Mérida before 1:00 p.m., allowing time for the transfer and guided city tour.

Mexico City is more than just the starting point of this journey. Over two sightseeing days, you will explore Aztec heritage, colonial architecture and the capital’s principal museum collections. The route then continues to the Yucatán, where Maya architecture takes centre stage: first the cities of the Puuc region, followed by Chichén Itzá. This sequence reveals several chapters of Mexico’s cultural history in one short trip.

After your excursions in Mérida, you have the evening free to walk its cobbled streets, see colonial buildings and parks, and explore local food. At Uxmal and Kabah, the focus is on architectural decoration, while Chichén Itzá offers a much wider range of monuments: the pyramid, ball court, observatory, colonnades and Sacred Cenote.
